purpose: Record narrowly scoped corrections to historically frozen compatibility fixtures without silently rewriting the compatibility locks.

entries.rule: kristal.v6:jcs-rfc8785 state identity includes extensions; only state_id, content_hash and signatures are excluded from the hash target.
entries.reason: The v7 portable projection added extensions.kristal_v7 but retained the base v6 fixture identity. The declared state_id/content_hash therefore did not match its own canonical v6 content.
